Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously stated the full moon frequency as “around 10 per year (about every 35 days),” which misinterprets the lunar cycle (actually ~29.53 days, ~12–13 full moons per year). Although later corrected, this was the first clear factual error in the reasoning.
